routines.semantics: Set each size in the current last descriptor to its live logical high address minus the stored base. Leave the writer open. Finalization may be repeated on that descriptor.

scenarios.observes: Compare provisional and finalized sizes and bases for separately written integer/double/character payloads.
Finalizing a begun segment with no component data writes three zero sizes.
Finalizing an existing last descriptor again recomputes sizes; newly appended data and prior links survive.
Close and reopen an unfinished writer, then finalize its persisted component bases.
Multiple batches per component and exact logical endpoint values survive a completed mixed segment.
A middle segment with no parts and a final populated segment have independent bases, sizes and links.
A read-only populated file retains the original DASUDI access failure while finalizing.
An initialized empty list contains the null pointer, which is not a readable last descriptor.
A plain DAS lacks integer address three for finalization.

routines.semantics: Follow the supplied descriptor’s backward pointer to its predecessor in the specified DLA. A null backward link returns found=false without a file read.

scenarios.observes: The first and only descriptor has no preceding segment.
Walk three uneven segments to the null backward link, comparing every owned word.
Start backward from a descriptor found by the forward iterator; no separate backward initialization is required.
Reverse direction at the middle, advancing back to the same terminal descriptor.
Traverse backward from a provisional segment with size words of minus one to its completed predecessor.
Retain two descriptor references in one file and traverse from each independently.
Walk every descriptor of the repository-authored four-segment tetrahedron DSK and terminate at its first link.
Use an actual valid descriptor after its token has been explicitly closed. Ownership rejects the call before native access.
